1.name: The Water Mill (expansion)

effects.text: Play 1 round where you may gain {coin}{coin}{coin} once per turn. Then {rotate}.

1.text: Play 1 round where you may gain {coin}{coin}{coin} once per turn. Then {rotate}.
1.helpText: This round, you may gain [money][money][money] once per turn (tip: turn it sideways to remember if you already used this effect). At the end of round, rotate this card.

2.name: Efficient Farming

effects.text: Discard 2 buildings to add sticker 1 to 1 land in play.

2.text: Play 1 round. {time} Discard 2 buildings to add sticker 1 to 1 land in play. Then {flip}.
2.helpText: This round, this card has a Time Effect: you may discard 2 buildings (grey banner) to add sticker 1 ([money]) to 1 land (green banner) in play. Remember that this ends your turn, but you do not discard this card since it is permanent. At the end of round, flip this card.

3.name: Surplus

effects.text: Play 1 round where lands that produce {coin} may produce {tradeGood} instead. Then {rotate}.

3.text: Play 1 round where lands that produce {coin} may produce {tradeGood} instead. Then {rotate}.
3.helpText: This round, this card has the Passive Effect: all lands (green banner) that have [money] production may produce [tradegoods] instead. Note that this is only for production, other effects that gain [money] do not count. At the end of round, rotate this card.

4.name: Obsolete Farms

effects.text: Play 1 round. Then destroy this and 1 card with {coin} production.

4.text: Play 1 round. Then destroy this and 1 card with {coin} production.
4.helpText: This round, there is no special effect. After the round, destroy 1 card in your kingdom with [money] production. Then destroy this card, add sticker 13k to your box's score path and add your new score next to it. The expansion is over and you may choose a new one to play.

description:
This is one of the 3 built-in expansions for Feudal Kingdom.  You may discover it between games to start the expansion. Before playing, purge 1 permanent card and perform a purge 12. You do not discover the first 2 cards of your deck when playing a built-in expansion. Instead, this permanent card will guide you through 4 rounds of play, with different effects on the different sides of the card.  After 4 rounds, add sticker 13k to your box's score path and write your new score next to it.

This expansion focuses on farming your lands, giving you [money] and some [tradegoods].
